The '''Adarian government''' was the corporate government of the [[Adari sector/Legends|Adari sector]].<ref name="EAA" /> Its seat was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adari]],<ref name="UAA" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Adarian/Legends|Adarian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and site of the Adarian government's "head office," the [[Hall of Decisions]]. It allowed small groups of Adarians to compete against other groups, which led to the rise of several Adarian companies, though they were all owned and controlled by the Adarian government.<ref name="EAA" />

Several millennia before the publication of ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''{{'s}} first draft<ref name="EAA" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Chronology note">According to ''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]'', the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was discovered two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the publication of ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''{{'s}} first draft. As ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' dates this event to the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], it can be determined that this manuscript was published in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the Adarian government was contacted by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which they quickly joined.<ref name="EAA" />
